markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 名词化就是**把一个动作变成一个名词**：decide → decision。句子会更短、更正式，适合写报告和邮件。聊天时少用，不然听着很生硬。

uses.zh: 动作变名词，句子更正式
uses.en: The [[decision]] to delay the release was hard.
uses.en_zh: 推迟发布这个决定很难做。

uses.zh: 把「怎么变了」说成一件事
uses.en: There was a big [[improvement]] in speed.

uses.zh: 把重点放在事情上，而不是人上
uses.en: The [[introduction]] of dark mode increased usage.
uses.en_zh: 推出深色模式让使用量增加了。

how.title: 怎么变成名词
how.rule: 大多数靠**加个尾巴**：-tion、-ment、-ance、-ness、-ity。有些词长得一样，直接当名词用。
how.tip: 拿不准就查词典：analyse 的名词是 analysis，fail 的名词是 failure，这些要单独记。

rewrite.title: 一句话怎么改
rewrite.rule: 三步走：**动作变名词**，**副词变形容词**，再找个简单的动词把句子撑起来，比如 there was、cause、lead to。

items.en: There was a sharp [[increase]] in prices.

items.rule: 原句：We analysed the data carefully and found two problems.
items.en: A careful [[analysis]] of the data showed two problems.
items.zh: 仔细分析数据后发现了两个问题。

items.rule: 原句：The server failed, so users couldn't log in.
items.en: The server [[failure]] stopped users from logging in.
items.zh: 服务器故障导致用户登录不了。

prep.title: 名词后面的小词
prep.rule: 变成名词后，常要配一个介词，**和名词一起记**：increase **in**、decision **on**、demand **for**、reduction **in**。

examples.en: There's been a big [[increase in]] crash reports.
examples.zh: 崩溃报告一下子多了很多。

examples.en: We need a [[decision on]] the new design by Friday.
examples.zh: 周五前我们需要对新设计拍板。

contrast.title: 比一比

this.meaning: 名词化：正式、简短，写报告用
this.en: The [[delay]] was caused by a supplier problem.

that.meaning: 动词句：口语、清楚，跟同事说
that.en: We [[were delayed]] because a supplier had a problem.

this.en: After the [[introduction]] of Face ID, logins went up.

that.en: After we [[introduced]] Face ID, logins went up.

commonMistakes.bad: There was a big ~~improve~~ in speed.
commonMistakes.good: There was a big [[improvement]] in speed.
commonMistakes.why: a big 后面要名词，improve 是动词。
修饰名词用形容词，不用副词。

commonMistakes.bad: A careful ~~analyse~~ of the data showed two problems.
commonMistakes.good: A careful [[analysis]] of the data showed two problems.

contrast.tip: 别名词化过头：一句话里一两个就够了，太多别人读着累。

quiz.prompt: The ___ to delay the release was hard.
名词化改写（用 There was…）：Prices increased sharply.
quiz.answer: There was a sharp increase in prices.

quiz.prompt: The server ___ stopped users from logging in.（fail 变名词）
We analysed the data carefully. → A ___ analysis of the data showed two problems.
quiz.explain: 动词变名词后，副词跟着变形容词：careful。

quiz.prompt: There's been a big increase ___ crash reports this week.
We need a decision ___ the new design by Friday.
改错：There was a big improve in speed.
quiz.answer: There was a big improvement in speed.

quiz.prompt: 改错：We need a quickly response from the client.
quiz.answer: We need a quick response from the client.

quiz.prompt: 哪一句更适合写进给老板的项目报告？
options: The delay was caused by a supplier problem.
We were late because the supplier messed up.
quiz.answer: The delay was caused by a supplier problem.
quiz.explain: 名词化的 [[delay]] 更正式、更简短。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：推出深色模式让使用量增加了。（用 The introduction of…）
quiz.answer: The introduction of dark mode increased usage.
accept: The introduction of dark mode led to an increase in usage.
The introduction of dark mode has increased usage.
The introduction of dark mode caused an increase in usage.
The introduction of dark mode increased use.

openTask.prompt: 把一段口语说的项目进展改成 2 到 3 句正式的周报，至少用到 2 个名词化的词（比如 improvement、decision、increase in）。
rules: 名词前面用形容词，不用副词
increase in / decision on / demand for 等介词搭配要对
openTask.note: 规则判名词形式和介词搭配（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
